raw_extract:
### Fees

Tuition fees for home students commencing their studies in September 2027 will be £10,050 per annum. Tuition fees for international students will be £29,200 per annum.

For general information please see the [undergraduate finance](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/fees-and-funding/) pages.
research_notes: Second Manchester course fetched on the same 2027 cycle, to demonstrate that the international figure is course-specific rather than a single institutional number: £29,200 (Liberal Arts, 4 years incl. year abroad) versus £39,700 (Computer Science) on the identically-worded Fees line. The 2026-entry URL was requested; the site served the 2027-entry profile (canonical path /study/undergraduate/courses/2027/19115/ba-liberal-arts-with-international-study/).

claims.statement: The University of Manchester charges international students £29,200 per annum for the BA Liberal Arts with International Study (4 years, 2027 entry).
